description: List invoices, optionally within a date window and filtered by status. Which date matters: service is when the work happened, created is when the invoice record was made, paid is when it settled, due is when payment is owed. Only service is filtered by this server walking pages, because Housecall Pro has no server-side filter for it. The other three are filtered by Housecall Pro itself, which is far faster and reads no more of the account than it has to - prefer one of them when it is the date you actually mean. The status filter is applied by Housecall Pro and verified here, so an all-open or all-paid pull is one narrow read instead of a whole-account walk. Canceled invoices keep their full balance, so anything summing money owed should filter them out.

date_field.description: Which date since/until apply to. Default service. created, paid and due are filtered by the API and are much cheaper than service.

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked (100 rows/page), default 10

min_due_dollars.description: Only invoices owing at least this much, in dollars. Filtered by the API.

since.description: Earliest date in the window, YYYY-MM-DD

statuses.description: Only invoices in these statuses, filtered by the API. paid, open and canceled are the vocabulary Housecall Pro actually uses on this route.

until.description: Latest date in the window, YYYY-MM-DD

name: hcp_list_invoices
